caption: A paint roller, dipped in green paint, is used to cover a section of a metal fence, creating a uniform green coat.

observations.R13C: Roller and fence are nearly static through frame68, with part of a hand/handle appearing at80; stable object appearance without a clear painting process.
observations.R13C_no_c: Roller moves and lays a darker strip, but its head collapses/vanishes in middle frames and fence bars disappear locally.
observations.R13C_key_modulation_off: Q-only restores roller motion, but head shape changes and fence structure is not consistently preserved.
observations.R1: Previously inspected panel showed roller motion with semi-transparent/changed roller shape and disappearing fence bars.
observations.score_limitation: Normal, no_c and Q-only all receive SA4/PC4. The intervention exposes an action-versus-object-integrity tradeoff not captured by the identical scores.

inference_intervention_scope: Same own400 checkpoint and verified common first-image pixels, caption, seed/noise, gamma and sampler. Historical-reference weights differ.
limitations: Sampled-frame diagnostic, not an aggregate quality score. No measured attention-to-first-frame attribution. More motion alone is not physical correctness. Numerical paired controls cover16 cases.
